title: Iquitos y el ciclo del caucho en la cuenca amazónica
goal: Explore the history of Iquitos as the world's largest roadless continental city, the rubber boom, and Shipibo art.
grammar: historia de la Amazonia peruana, ciclo extractivo del caucho y cosmología del kené shipibo

items: Explore the unique geographic isolation and Amazon river hub status of Iquitos.
Analyze the economic wealth and human rights tragedy of the 19th-century rubber boom.
Deploy Amazonian geography, fluvial transport, and indigenous art vocabulary (caucho, fluvial, siringuero, kené).
